alert: Loom Ready-stage ETAs stale or unanswered

A.name: A
A.query:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv(timestamp, 1000000000)), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS ts,
       resources_string['host.id'] AS host,
       countIf(NOT mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.no_estimate_reason')) AS answered,
       countIf(attributes_string['loom.eta.no_estimate_reason'] = 'stale_inputs') AS stale,
       count() AS total,
       toFloat64(answered = 0 AND stale * 2 >= total) AS value
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.trigger')
  AND attributes_string['loom.eta.stage'] = 'ready_wait'
  AND timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
  AND timestamp < {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
GROUP BY ts, host
ORDER BY ts

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} emitted ready_wait ETA records in a 10 min bucket with zero answered and at least half refused stale_inputs. Ready items exist (each has a record) but none got an estimate: the work finder is stalled, often on a full disk (see Loom host worktree disk critical). Check host.health dispatch_halted/halt_reason and fleet.etaAuthority; see troubleshooting.md 'Worker disk full'. Total silence (no records) is the separate no-ETAs-emitted watchdog. Issue #10973.
